blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China— President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday said the Philippines is in talks with Elon Musk’s SpaceX to explore making the country one of its rocket launch sites, citing its geographical location. In a press briefing here before returning to Manila, Marcos said the government was looking to tap into the commercial space launch business rather than develop a program focused on sending astronauts to the moon or Mars.
